notes.title: Update 1.19
notes.content:
Hi all,

In this update, fighter retirement has been introduced to the game!

When a fighter turns 34, if they hit a losing streak of 3 fights they will now retire.

If they turn 47, they will retire. This seems like a good number that is pretty far past the point of realism and a good starting point for a firm retirement age. (May adjust this in the future)

New fighters will also generate every other month now so there will be a steady stream of up and comers to take their places.

This add some longevity to a playthrough and keep each game more fresh.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 1.18
notes.content:
Hey all,

Hope you're doing okay through this pandemic the world is going through right now. (Never thought I'd say that in an update.)

Here's a run down of what's new in version 1.18, it's a big one!

[h3]Changes to simulating time progressing[/h3]
To sim forward in time, there is only one button now instead of the previous three (day, week, month) - once pressed it will automatically sim 1 day each second. There's two reasons for this:

    • It was easy to miss mail messages before, which could mean missed fight contracts / fighter departure warnings etc. 
    • Now you will be able to see fighter skills going up in real time (in the training screen and profile)

The only downside I can see to this method is getting to the next event - maybe you don't need to watch your fighter skills changing for a while. 

If that's the case, you can go to the event preview screen and click 'Sim to Event' to simulate each day up to the event.

[h3]New art![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33380887/7432969ac2cc45aba34b5ca74a494f9624089064.png[/img]

It's been a while since anyone has mentioned it, but when the game was released the fighter art was often regarded in a not so positive light. I didn't disagree, some of the 3D models looked like they'd cooked too long in the microwave.

I hired an artist to replace all of the portraits with more stylized fighters. I really like the new look, and it gives the game a unique style that works way better than trying to look realistic like before.

[h3]Skill indicators[/h3]

If you simulate days while in the training screen, skills will now turn green briefly as they raise. Injuries will show up in red both here and on the fighter profile screen.

[h3]Fighter profile screen improvements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33380887/5bc44c6838736318ab7b41e5a77c223d00c22c00.png[/img]

The fighter profile screen has had some minor improvements. I will probably revamp this screen entirely in the future, but for now it's a start.

There's now a training button here to take you directly to the training schedule for the fighter you are currently viewing.

[h3]Mail screen improvements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33380887/3c4ed6892379173ea4ffd41cc4f083b57026b8e0.png[/img]

The mail screen has been completely revamped - it still functions the exact same, but looks much better than when I originally created it. 

[h3]Event breakdown screen improvements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33380887/855db2a921ecfdb9984f17349d78bbf4873f9793.png[/img]

Not a total revamp, but similar to the mail screen I replaced some outdated elements I relied on when it was made.

[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
Fatigue now reduces while a fighter is injured. 

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
Fixed possibility of gym initially starting with 0 fighters

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
My next priority is improving the fighter database - adding retirement for fighters along with new ones coming up through the ranks. As always I'll be improving the playability where I can too.

Any feedback is greatly appreciated and helps me out a lot. Right now aside from the Steam forums, there is a subreddit you can post to at https://reddit.com/r/mmasimulator

Thanks for playing and stay safe out there!

Nick

notes.title: Update 1.17
notes.content:
Hey all,

This one is a wall of text!

Update 1.17 revamps the finance system to make the game both more flexible AND have consequences based on your money management.

Previously, fighters and coaches could only be recruited if your monthly income was high enough – this was purely based off of income from classes, not from your money in the bank.

Now, you can make offers that as long as your total cash amount can support, they can go through without that arbitrary limitation. The new offer formula is income from classes + bank / 12

In addition to this, expenses are now being calculated by adding up your fighter and coach contracts, along with rent. (Previously, only fighter contracts and an arbitrary class expense were being calculated) If you cannot pay your expenses, your highest contract amount fighter will leave. If you run out of fighters, coaches will start leaving.

There will be a warning in the mail if a month starts and your total cash is lower than your expenses.

As a result of this, I bumped the starting money amount of money up from $10000 to $40000 to make it easier to get used to. I might change this later, depending on feedback.

Expenses used to be subtracted on an arbitrary date, they are now subtracted at the end of each month. Income is added on the first of each month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33380887/04d9c931792bcab19d7c95c9d2f96df6d5f51e6e.png[/img]

To make tracking all of this data easier, I’ve added a finance breakdown modal that can be accessed from the gym screen. It will show you how much you’re paying for every fighter, coach, and rent. It will also show how much income you’re generating from fights and classes. (Income is also displayed as class income + monthly fight income on the main screen)

If you have any feedback, let me know. This is one of the biggest changes made to the game in a while and it’s much better than it was before.

Thanks for playing!

Misc notes:
[list]
[*]Created fighters are still free to make and I have extended their contract to 10 years.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused certain mail to not save.
[*]Fixed contract values not loading.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.15
notes.content:
Hi all,

I hope everyone that bought the game on sale or received a copy during the giveaway on Reddit is enjoying it.

This update addresses a lot of bugs, most of which were reported by TheZygoteTalentShow  - big thanks to him for pointing them out to me!

[h1]Issues fixed[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fatigue not reducing properly for some fighters (improved formula used to calculate this)
[*] Sometimes inaccurate judging from spectated fights
[*] Fighter 1/2 has won message on spectated fights
[*] Blank fight results on the event result screen (related to the above fix)
[*] Certain mail not deleting when OK is pressed
[*] Spar intensity crash when selecting hard or light
[*] Crash if you had 0 fighters in your gym (related to new gym rankings)
[/list]

Also just for awareness, any crash bug fixes are implemented as soon as they are reported and fixed which is always before these posts.


[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]

A while back the game used to be Wet Blanket simulator, fighters would shoot for takedowns far too often. However, I had changed the game to the point that they hardly ever shot and basically never would get submissions.

To address this, I scaled back those changes to allow more take downs and also reduced the difficulty on submissions.

[list]
[*] Fighters will also be more likely to shoot for a takedown if they have higher jiu jitsu.
[*] Minor UI improvements / message clarifications
[/list]

There will also be new fighter portraits in a month or so - I know the current ones are pretty damn hideous ;)

That's all for now, thanks for playing!

Nick

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
Sup fight fans?

It's been a minute since I released an update, I hope 2019 has been treating you well! 

I've created the [url=https://reddit.com/r/mmasimulator]/r/mmasimulator[/url] subreddit where you can talk about the game, report bugs, make suggestions and catch some live events together!

There is now a [url=http://mmasimulator.net/devroadmap/]development roadmap[/url] where you can keep up with what I'm working on. 

Here are the changes in the new version: 

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] In the recruit screen you can now click on column names to sort the values by ascending or descending order.

[*] Multiple organizations in! Simulate up to three organizations running at the same time.

[*] Picture path saving - in the options screen you can define a folder where your pictures are so you don't have to navigate to a specific folder every time you upload a custom image for a fighter.

[*] When watching fights, they can now be paused.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Organization names are randomized now.

[*] Start event button can no longer be double clicked leading to crashes.

[*] Event result bug that would have a blank box for both fighters (and every fight in that slot that happened after that) is now resolved.

[*] Coach generation is now working as intended - a mistake in the SQL query was causing free agent coaches to not generate.

[*] Events now will not have 3 or more fights in the same division.

[*] A few screens have had their interface improved. I am going to continue improving the interface across the game.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] You can no longer set the amount of starting fighters on new game or starting money.

[*] Starting money has been reduced.

[*] Coach salaries are now higher.
[/list]

Regarding balance changes, I feel like the objective of the game (running your own gym) hasn't been fine tuned enough. Previously when you started a game you kind of had everything already and it lacked purpose.

The goal is to create a solid sense of progression when you're upgrading your gym's equipment, fighters and coaches. I am going to keep making changes similar to the above to enhance the experience. 

You can still create as many fighters as you like or edit the database values if you want to.

I can confidently say this is the best version of MMA Simulator yet! It's been great to work on the game again and I look forward to where it is going.

Thank you for playing!

-Nick

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Here's what is new in 1.07:

1. Background music is now available.

A lot of people wanted some kind of music to listen to rather than just silence, so I've added nine songs that will play in the background.You can turn it on or off via the options menu.

It's really difficult to find good songs that aren't expensive / copyrighted, so if they aren't to your liking I recommend listening to Spotify as an alternative. ːsteamhappyː

2. The cornering system is now in! You can now coach a fighter that belongs to your gym when spectating a fight. (In events or sparring)

Here's how it works:

Each turn, you can issue a corner command. Your fighter has a high chance to follow the command but it isn't guaranteed.

This will show what you're telling them to do on the same side of the screen your fighter is on. Once that text disappears, you can issue another command.

A few things to note:

Spamming more than one command a turn does not change the command or increase the chances of the command to succeed.

If the fighter is in the clinch or on the ground, you can use the respective command for the position to give them a slight skill boost to help them! This simulates corners giving ground / clinch position advice in real fights.

That's it for this one! I hope you guys are enjoying the game.

All the best,

Nick
